name: local/ai-novel-system
description: AI 小说创作系统 1.8.1 PRO（单用户自部署）

suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required for image and uploaded-file MIME validation; optional for installation.

scripts-descriptions.test:frontend: Run writing, transport, drama, and CSP event behavior regressions; requires Node.js 18+ and makes no external requests.
scripts-descriptions.test:csp-browser: Verify report-only and enforced CSP against the production layout in an isolated local browser; requires Playwright and a Chromium browser, and does not load config.php or a database.
scripts-descriptions.test:component: Hard-kill and restart the real Harness worker mid-SSE, then verify expired-lease reclaim, fencing, exactly-once commit, and two local HTTP requests; NOVEL_TEST_DB_ISOLATED=1 is mandatory.
scripts-descriptions.test:concurrency: Repeat unit lease/fence contracts and run independent proc_open/PDO races; defaults to 100 release-grade repetitions, PR may explicitly select 5, NOVEL_TEST_DB_ISOLATED=1 is mandatory, and missing safe DB config is non-green.
scripts-descriptions.test:fault: Run crash, retry, recovery, and dead-letter contracts.
scripts-descriptions.test:fault:process: Run the isolated-DB proc_open OS hard-kill/restart matrix through production WorkflowRunner and M62 persistence; missing safe DB config is non-green.
scripts-descriptions.test:fault:canon: Run the isolated-DB four-point OS hard-kill/restart matrix through the production LegacyWriteEngineStageAdapter and real Canon transaction; missing safe DB config is non-green.
scripts-descriptions.test:eval: Run the offline hard suite bound to the production Canon gate and workflow hashes without writing a report.
scripts-descriptions.test:ci: Compatibility alias for the one authoritative test:release pipeline; it cannot drift into a weaker CI-only gate.
scripts-descriptions.test: 运行无 DB 依赖的单元测试（tests/unit）
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: 运行 DB 集成测试（需安全 NOVEL_TEST_DB_* 与 NOVEL_TEST_DB_ISOLATED=1，缺省自动 skip）
scripts-descriptions.test:all: 运行 tests/ 根目录下全部过程式静态测试（tests/run_all_tests.php 聚合执行，支持 --filter=关键字 传参筛选）
scripts-descriptions.test:quick: 日常快速门禁（数分钟）：unit + 全部静态契约测试；不含 DB/进程/前端套件，不能替代 test:release
scripts-descriptions.test:full: 开发环境全量验证：unit + Node.js 前端行为测试 + integration（缺省 skip）+ 全部静态契约测试，任一失败整体非零退出
scripts-descriptions.test:release: 唯一严格发布门禁：真实 worker component + 独立 PDO concurrency + 内存/真实进程 fault + Eval 漂移 + unit + Node.js 前端行为 + 必须零 skip 的 integration/evidence + 静态契约
